```yaml
name: Compile Time Tracker

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'ttnn/cpp/ttnn/operations/transformer/**'
      - 'ttnn/cpp/ttnn/operations/transformer/**/nanobind.cpp'
      - '.github/workflows/compile-time-tracker.yaml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  track-compile-time:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          format: 'space-delimited'
          filter: 'ttnn/cpp/ttnn/operations/transformer/.*\.(cpp|hpp)$'

      - name: Check if transformer files changed
        id: check-changes
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.modified }}" ] || [ -n "${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.added }}" ]; then
            echo "transformer_changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "transformer_changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Setup Python
        if: steps.check-changes.outputs.transformer_changed == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.check-changes.outputs.transformer_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Measure compile time impact
        if: steps.check-changes.outputs.transformer_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          # This is a placeholder for actual compile time measurement logic
          # In a real scenario, you would trigger a build and measure time
          # For now, we just log the changed files
          echo "Changed transformer files:"
          echo "${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.modified }}"
          echo "${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.added }}"
          
          # Create a summary file
          echo "## Compile Time Impact Analysis" > compile_impact.md
          echo "" >> compile_impact.md
          echo "### Changed Files" >> compile_impact.md
          echo '```' >> compile_impact.md
          echo "${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.modified }}" >> compile_impact.md
          echo "${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.added }}" >> compile_impact.md
          echo '```' >> compile_impact.md
          echo "" >> compile_impact.md
          echo "### Notes" >> compile_impact.md
          echo "- Migration from struct-based to plain functions" >> compile_impact.md
          echo "- Expected compile time improvement due to reduced boilerplate" >> compile_impact.md
          echo "- Simplified nanobind bindings" >> compile_impact.md

      - name: Post comment with analysis
        if: steps.check-changes.outputs.transformer_changed == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const content = fs.readFileSync('compile_impact.md', 'utf8');
            
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: content
            });

      - name: Skip if no transformer changes
        if: steps.check-changes.outputs.transformer_changed == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "No transformer operation files changed. Skipping compile time tracking."
```
